description: The ontology has been developed in the framework of the Dem@Care project for representing the experimentation protocol towards diagnostic support and assessment of Dementia in a controlled environment. The aim of the protocol is to provide a brief overview of their health status of the participants during consultation (cognition, behaviours and function), and to correlate the system (sensor) data with the data collected using typical dementia care assessment tools.

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?details
WHERE {
    dcterms:RFC5646 rdfs:seeAlso ?document .
    FILTER(?document = <http://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc5646.txt>) .
    BIND(?document AS ?details)
}

qualified_questions.question: [Intermediate] Which classes have the most instances in the ontology, and why?

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT ?class (COUNT(DISTINCT ?instance) AS ?count)
WHERE {
    ?instance rdf:type ?class .
    FILTER (?class = dcterms:BibliographicResource || 
            ?class = dcterms:FileFormat || 
            ?class = dcterms:LocationPeriodOrJurisdiction || 
            ?class = dcterms:PeriodOfTime || 
            ?class = dcterms:SizeOrDuration)
}
GROUP BY ?class
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

qualified_questions.question: [Intermediate] What are the relationships between DDC, TGN, and LCC?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX dcam: <http://purl.org/dc/dcam/>

SELECT ?relationship ?DDC ?TGN ?LCC
WHERE {
    { ?DDC rdf:type dcam:VocabularyEncodingScheme .
      ?TGN rdf:type dcam:VocabularyEncodingScheme .
      ?LCC rdf:type dcam:VocabularyEncodingScheme .
      BIND("VocabularyEncodingScheme" AS ?relationship) }
    UNION
    { ?DDC rdfs:seeAlso ?seeAlsoDDC .
      ?TGN rdfs:seeAlso ?seeAlsoTGN .
      ?LCC rdfs:seeAlso ?seeAlsoLCC .
      BIND("seeAlso" AS ?relationship) }
    UNION
    { ?DDC dcterms:hasVersion ?versionDDC .
      ?TGN dcterms:hasVersion ?versionTGN .
      ?LCC dcterms:hasVersion ?versionLCC .
      BIND("hasVersion" AS ?relationship) }
    UNION
    { ?DDC rdfs:isDefinedBy ?definedByDDC .
      ?TGN rdfs:isDefinedBy ?definedByTGN .
      ?LCC rdfs:isDefinedBy ?definedByLCC .
      BIND("isDefinedBy" AS ?relationship) }
    FILTER((?DDC = dcterms:DDC && ?TGN = dcterms:TGN && ?LCC = dcterms:LCC))
}

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?dateFormat ?comparison
WHERE {
    dcterms:date rdfs:range ?dateFormat .
    dcterms:issued rdfs:subPropertyOf dc:date .
    BIND(xsd:date AS ?dateFormat) .
    BIND("dcterms:issued is a subproperty of dc:date, and dcterms:date has the same range as xsd:date" AS ?comparison) .
}

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] Can an Agent, as defined by dcterms:AgentClass, have multiple versions, as suggested by <http://dublincore.org/usage/terms/history/#Agent-001>?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?agent ?version
WHERE {
    ?agent rdf:type dcterms:AgentClass .
    ?agent dcterms:hasVersion ?version .
}

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] What is the significance of having an issued property, such as dcterms:issued, in this context, especially considering its version history <http://dublincore.org/usage/terms/history/#issued-003>?
[Simple] What is the purpose of tracking version history for an Agent, as seen in <http://dublincore.org/usage/terms/history/#Agent-001>?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?purpose 
WHERE {
    dcterms:Agent dcterms:hasVersion ?version .
    ?version rdfs:comment ?purpose .
    FILTER (?version = <http://dublincore.org/usage/terms/history/#Agent-001>)
}

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] How is the version history of isVersionOf, specifically <http://dublincore.org/usage/terms/history/#isVersionOf-003>, relevant to understanding this ontology?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?version ?property ?value
WHERE {
    dcterms:isVersionOf rdfs:subPropertyOf ?property .
    BIND(dcterms:isVersionOf AS ?version) .
    FILTER(?version = dcterms:isVersionOf) .
    dcterms:Agent dcterms:hasVersion ?o .
    BIND(dcterms:hasVersion AS ?property) .
    BIND(?o AS ?value) .
}

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] In what way does dc:description relate to other descriptive properties in this context?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>

SELECT ?property ?relation
WHERE {
    ?property rdfs:subPropertyOf dc:description .
    ?property rdfs:subPropertyOf ?relation .
}

qualified_questions.question: [Simple] Is there a difference between dcterms:description and other description properties in how they are used here?
qualified_questions.sparql_query:
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>

SELECT ?property ?superProperty
WHERE {
    dcterms:description rdfs:subPropertyOf+ ?superProperty .
    ?property rdfs:subPropertyOf ?superProperty .
    FILTER (?property = dcterms:abstract)
}
